official_update_note: ClinGen says dosage curated gene TSV files are updated daily; the FTP index is refreshed nightly.

G2P was redesigned as a Vue SPA in 2025. The old DDG2P.csv.gz static download URL is gone. Use the new API endpoint: /api/panel/{panel}/download (CSV, not gzipped). AllG2P covers all panels including DD, Eye, Skin, Cancer, Cardiac.
GoFCards (NAR 2025, 53:D976-D988, PMID:39578693) is a curated GOF variant database. Updates follow publication cycles.
Orphadata Product 6 contains disorder-gene relationship types. PriVA retains only assessed relationships whose type explicitly states a germline gain-of-function or loss-of-function mechanism.
PanelApp is curator/API-backed and does not publish one fixed bulk release cycle; panel versions expose version_created timestamps.
